informal_statement: The density integral against a given boundary measure.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. This is the low-level weighted integral against the explicitly supplied boundary measure, as the author says. The canonical choice is imposed at the admissible-competitor perimeter definition, so this auxiliary measure parameter is not a freedom in the minimization problem.
